problems.quote: February 2015 through an amendment to the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
problems.problem: The inflation-targeting framework was adopted in February 2015 via a Monetary Policy Framework Agreement; the RBI Act was amended later in May 2015 (Finance Act, 2015), not in February 2015.
problems.correction: February 2015 via a government‑RBI agreement, with the RBI Act amended in May 2015
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly states RBI Act amended in Feb 2015; amendment via Finance Act occurred May 2015. Correction accurately separates agreement (Feb) and statutory amendment (May).

problems.quote: In India the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) publishes a “CPI‑Core” series that excludes the food and fuel groups
problems.problem: The RBI does not publish CPI series; the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) is the official publisher of CPI data, including the CPI excluding food and fuel. The RBI uses MoSPI's data for core inflation analysis.
problems.correction: MoSPI publishes a “CPI‑Excluding Food and Fuel” series that the RBI uses as a core inflation measure
problems.verifierReason: RBI does not publish CPI series; MoSPI (NSO) is the official publisher. Correction correctly attributes publication to MoSPI and notes RBI usage.

problems.quote: The first Indian IIBs were issued in 1997
problems.problem: The 1997 bonds were Capital Indexed Bonds linked to the Wholesale Price Index (WPI), not Consumer Price Index (CPI)-linked Inflation-Indexed Bonds (IIBs). The first CPI-linked IIBs were issued in 2013.
problems.correction: The first Indian CPI-linked IIBs were issued in 2013
problems.verifierReason: 1997 bonds were Capital Indexed Bonds (WPI-linked), not IIBs. First CPI-linked IIBs issued in 2013.

problems.quote: forthcoming Digital Personal Data Protection Act
problems.problem: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 received presidential assent on 11 August 2023 and is already enacted, not forthcoming.
problems.correction: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
problems.verifierReason: The Act has already received assent in Aug 2023; correction accurately reflects its status.

problems.quote: 30 % collection and recycling of rigid plastic packaging by 2025‑26
problems.problem: The Plastic Waste Management (Amendment) Rules, 2022 set the 30% EPR target for rigid plastic packaging for 2024‑25, not 2025‑26.
problems.correction: 30 % collection and recycling of rigid plastic packaging by 2024‑25
problems.verifierReason: EPR target for rigid plastic is 30% by 2024‑25 per 2022 amendment, not 2025‑26.

problems.quote: established in 2012 under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) through an Act of Parliament
problems.problem: NIFTEM was established in 2012 as a society under MoFPI; it was granted Institute of National Importance status through an Act of Parliament in 2021, not at its establishment.
problems.correction: established in 2012 under MoFPI as a society; declared an Institute of National Importance through an Act of Parliament in 2021
problems.verifierReason: NIFTEM was set up as a society in 2012 and became an INI via a 2021 Act; correction is accurate.

problems.quote: RBI’s 2022 'External Benchmark‑Based Lending Rate' (EBLR) mandate
problems.problem: The EBLR mandate was introduced in 2019 (effective Oct 1, 2019), not 2022. The 2022 circular extended EBLR to personal loans and MSEs, but the original mandate was 2019.
problems.correction: RBI’s 2019 'External Benchmark‑Based Lending Rate' (EBLR) mandate
problems.verifierReason: EBLR mandate was 2019, not 2022; correction fixes year accurately.

problems.quote: a 15 % rise in Brent crude (from $108 to $124 per barrel)
problems.problem: Brent crude rose from ~$108 (Apr 2013) to ~$115 (Aug 2013), a ~6% increase, not 15% to $124.
problems.correction: a 6 % rise in Brent crude (from $108 to $115 per barrel)
problems.verifierReason: Brent rose ~6% to ~$115 in Aug 2013, not 15% to $124; correction matches data.

problems.quote: a 12 % depreciation of the rupee (₹54 to ₹61 per USD)
problems.problem: The rupee depreciated from ~₹54 (Apr 2013) to ~₹69 (Aug 2013), a ~27% fall, not 12% to ₹61.
problems.correction: a 27 % depreciation of the rupee (₹54 to ₹69 per USD)
problems.verifierReason: Rupee fell ~27% to ~₹69 by Aug 2013, not 12% to ₹61; correction is correct.

problems.quote: WPI inflation jumped from 4.7 % (April 2013) to 7.5 % (August 2013)
problems.problem: WPI inflation was 4.7% in April 2013 and 6.1% in August 2013, not 7.5%.
problems.correction: WPI inflation rose from 4.7 % (April 2013) to 6.1 % (August 2013)
problems.verifierReason: WPI was 6.1% in Aug 2013, not 7.5%; correction uses correct figure.

problems.quote: CPI inflation rose from 9.3 % to 10.7 % over the same period
problems.problem: CPI inflation was 9.39% in April 2013 and 9.52% in August 2013; 10.7% was reached in October 2013.
problems.correction: CPI inflation rose from 9.4 % to 9.5 % over the same period
problems.verifierReason: CPI was 9.5% in Aug 2013, not 10.7%; correction rounds correctly to 9.4-9.5%.

problems.quote: the RBI unwound GSAP and resumed conventional tightening
problems.problem: The RBI discontinued GSAP purchases but did not unwind (sell) the acquired bonds; 'unwind' implies reversal of purchases.
problems.correction: the RBI discontinued GSAP and resumed conventional tightening
problems.verifierReason: RBI discontinued GSAP purchases but did not sell (unwind) the bonds; 'discontinued' is accurate.

problems.quote: The RBI’s “High‑Frequency Indicators” initiative already experiments with scraping UPI and card‑network data to nowcast inflation
problems.problem: RBI's High-Frequency Indicators initiative uses traditional indicators (PMI, GST, etc.), not scraping UPI/card data; such scraping is done by researchers, not an official RBI initiative.
problems.correction: Researchers experiment with scraping UPI and card‑network data to nowcast inflation
problems.verifierReason: Official RBI HFI uses traditional indicators; UPI/card scraping is done by researchers, not an RBI initiative.

problems.quote: RBI’s 2019 introduction of a counter‑cyclical capital buffer (CCyB) framework
problems.problem: The CCyB framework was introduced by RBI in 2015 (Basel III guidelines), not 2019.
problems.correction: RBI’s 2015 introduction of a counter‑cyclical capital buffer (CCyB) framework
problems.verifierReason: CCyB framework introduced in 2015 Basel III guidelines, not 2019; 2015 correction is accurate.

problems.quote: 2021 National Logistics Policy
problems.problem: The National Logistics Policy was launched in September 2022, not 2021.
problems.correction: 2022 National Logistics Policy
problems.verifierReason: National Logistics Policy launched Sept 2022, not 2021; correction accurate.

problems.quote: 5 % GST on the 'supply of fuel to aircraft'
problems.problem: ATF is kept outside the GST regime; there is no 5% GST on ATF supply.
problems.correction: ATF kept outside GST (no GST on fuel supply)
problems.verifierReason: ATF is outside GST regime; no GST on aviation fuel supply.

problems.quote: compound annual growth rate of roughly 45 %
problems.problem: From 12,146 chargers (Dec 2023) to 1.32 million (2030) implies ~98% CAGR, not 45%.
problems.correction: compound annual growth rate of roughly 100 %
problems.verifierReason: Given figures (12k to 1.32M in ~6.25 yrs) imply ~110% CAGR; 45% is wrong, ~100% is reasonable approx.

problems.quote: Railway Station Development Authority' (RSDA)
problems.problem: IRSDC was dissolved in 2022; station redevelopment is now handled by Rail Land Development Authority (RLDA), not RSDA.
problems.correction: Rail Land Development Authority (RLDA)
problems.verifierReason: IRSDC dissolved 2022; station redevelopment now under RLDA, not RSDA.

problems.quote: based on the European Train Control System (ETCS) Level 2
problems.problem: Only Western DFC uses ETCS Level 2; Eastern DFC uses ETCS Level 1.
problems.correction: with Western DFC using ETCS Level 2 and Eastern DFC using Level 1
problems.verifierReason: Western DFC uses ETCS L2, Eastern DFC uses L1; quote incorrectly generalizes to L2.

problems.quote: announced in the Union Budget 2023‑24
problems.problem: Amrit Bharat Station Scheme was launched by the Prime Minister on 6 February 2023, not announced in the Budget.
problems.correction: launched in February 2023
problems.verifierReason: Amrit Bharat Station Scheme launched by PM on 6 Feb 2023, not announced in Budget 2023-24.

problems.quote: The 1993 Liberalised Exchange Rate Management System (LERMS)
problems.problem: LERMS was introduced in March 1992, not 1993.
problems.correction: The 1992 Liberalised Exchange Rate Management System (LERMS)
problems.verifierReason: LERMS launched March 1, 1992; 1993 is incorrect.

problems.quote: the subsequent unified exchange rate in 1994
problems.problem: The unified exchange rate was introduced in March 1993, not 1994.
problems.correction: the subsequent unified exchange rate in 1993
problems.verifierReason: Unified market rate started March 1, 1993; 1994 is incorrect.

problems.quote: India’s transition from a managed float (pre‑1993)
problems.problem: Pre‑1993 India had a fixed exchange rate regime, not a managed float.
problems.correction: India’s transition from a fixed exchange rate regime (pre‑1993)
problems.verifierReason: Pre-1993 regime was fixed/pegged, not managed float; correction accurate.
